race.comment: Tricky. SHAMANSARA (13) can be forgiven for last start at Sandown Lakeside when getting a long way back and in the worse going. The debut win rated very well before a good effort two back. This is easier again and with any luck in running she can bounce back. I STAND BY YOU (7) was okay first up at Geelong in this grade but should be a sharp improver second up. He's lightly raced and gets a good map. ILLUMINANCE (9) is maddeningly consistent without winning, another narrow placing last time. She'll be right there again. BAGANOV (5) resumes with a handy profile and is fitter for recent hit-outs, the latest placing in a Flemington jump-out. Watch the betting.
